MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "I Dreamed A Dream feels especially right because expressive singing and musical-theater material connect directly with what I enjoyed in Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Partners, To Be Loved, and Cheek to Cheek appeal through melodic vocals, duets, and standards; those qualities connect with my interest in Lead With Your Heart and Under One Sky."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums connect with my past listening, but wanting holiday music then does not mean I want it now, even when the vocal harmonies appeal.",
    "Blown Away and Down To My Last Bad Habit feel less suited to my current desire for gentle, expressive vocal music; my interest in 747 and Golden is not enough to make them immediate choices.",
    "The Very Best Of gives me too little information to judge a connection: I need to know the artist or songs before I would choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My earlier Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing desire for more holiday albums.",
    "My interest in 747 and Golden seems to have carried more weight than whether a recommendation fits the gentler listening mood I want today."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The calm mood suggested by my most recent choice, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, matters alongside my recurring interest in expressive voices and orchestral accompaniment.",
    "Several duet albums can suit my taste without all being choices I would make now: Duets II interests me, but I would choose Partners first."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in expressive, melodic singing but carried past holiday and country interests too far into my current gentler mood."
}
